paragraphs.label: Mở thư và từ chối
paragraphs.text:

Thanks for inviting me to a neighbourhood walking event. It sounds interesting, and I would have liked to join you. Unfortunately, I cannot come on Saturday at nine in the morning. I am really sorry to miss it.
